author: Bobby Grayson
description: A supervision-tree round would need: Application.start/2 and the children list as an initial Sys configuration (spawnLink per child in order), {Registry, keys: :duplicate} as a real modelled component since it is a broadcast fan-out, Phoenix.PubSub as a child rather than an ambient effect, and a policy for infrastructure children (Repo/Endpoint/Telemetry) that are outside the model. The payoff is the first property about a real APPLICATION rather than a real module: e.g. every listener registered in the duplicate Registry receives every broadcast.
title: Round 9 candidate identified while round 8 runs: we translate individual modules, never a whole application. Every real program is a supervision tree plus interacting GenServers. Smallest real tree: bobs_broadcast (9 children, 33 lines) whose only project-owned worker is Radio.Broadcaster alongside PubSub and a duplicate-key Registry; the rest (Telemetry, Repo, DNSCluster, Endpoint) are infrastructure that would be modelled as opaque or excluded. loom and ensemble have 14 children each
